schemas.$comment: The templates screen's show_template action: shows one template's page of the templates screen. Sent as the next step after the screen domain's mount_ext; the screen's handler replaces its own entry through its app's navigation facade. Self-contained and closed, as template-mfe's action schemas are.

target.$comment: The screen that shows the page: the only target of this action

template.$comment: The template whose page to show: one of the templates the screen presents

seo.title: Templates
seo.description: FrontX project templates: start an application from the shell, add the MFE workspace or design guardrails, or reuse the templates of this site.

/template-shell.title: Shell template
/template-shell.description: The FrontX shell template: a host application that boots, routes and mounts screen microfrontends, with its key files and how to start.

/template-mfe.title: MFE workspace template
/template-mfe.description: The FrontX MFE workspace template: isolated screen packages with their own build and host bridge, with its key files and next steps.

/template-design-guardrails.title: Design guardrails template
/template-design-guardrails.description: The FrontX design guardrails template: design rules, a design-defect checker and accessibility checks for people and coding agents.

/template-site.title: Site sections template
/template-site.description: The template of this site's own sections: home, templates and docs screens with a content model that also publishes plain text.

/template-site-meta.title: Site metadata template
/template-site-meta.description: The site metadata template: head tags, sitemap, robots, llms.txt and plain-text twins generated from each screen's seo block.

/template-site-brand.title: Site brand template
/template-site-brand.description: The site brand template: brand token values over the UI kit from one record, the typeface, a document entry and a brand check.

/template-kit-candidates.title: Kit candidates template
/template-kit-candidates.description: The kit candidates template: typography, link, code block and description list components proposed to the UI kit, in its own API.

/template-site-blocks.title: Site blocks template
/template-site-blocks.description: The site blocks template: section-level compositions of UI kit components on layout tokens, with a showcase screen for every block.

/template-catalogue.title: UI kit catalogue template
/template-catalogue.description: The UI kit catalogue template: a page per @gears-frontx/ui-kit component with its example, its source and how to install it.

/template-inbox.title: Inbox template
/template-inbox.description: The inbox demo template: contacts, dashboard, chat and mail screens built from the UI kit with mocked API services.

/template-mfe-demo.title: MFE mechanics demo template
/template-mfe-demo.description: The MFE mechanics demo template: screens and widget packages that show the bridge, actions and a nested extension domain.

/template-calendar-demo.title: Calendar demo template
/template-calendar-demo.description: The calendar demo template: a calendar screen in the demos menu, a placeholder page built from ui-kit components while a calendar kit is in development.
